assist.scope: source-addressed downside, execution-risk and falsifier evidence only; no numeric underwriting or risk score

claims.claim: Mobileye purchases all EyeQ SoCs from a single supplier, so supplier manufacturing, delivery, quality or cost disruption is a direct operating dependency rather than a hypothetical generic semiconductor risk.
claims.possibleImprovement: demonstrated qualified supply redundancy, contractual resilience, or inventory/production evidence that materially lowers interruption exposure
claims.falsifier: A future filing showing qualified multi-source EyeQ supply or equivalent architecture portability with demonstrated production scale would weaken this risk.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $508M, essentially flat year over year; system shipments rose 3% but lower EyeQ ASP, mainly from higher China OEM export volumes, offset that volume growth. Adjusted gross margin also declined because of lower ASP and a greater SuperVision hardware mix.
claims.observedWeakness: volume growth did not translate proportionally into revenue or gross-margin expansion
claims.possibleImprovement: evidence of stabilized/rising system ASP, favorable product mix, or advanced-product revenue scaling faster than hardware-content costs
claims.falsifier: Sustained revenue growth materially above shipment growth with stable or improving gross margin would weaken the pricing/mix concern.

claims.claim: The large Q2 improvement in adjusted operating income was primarily attributable to an Israeli R&D incentive grant recognized for the first half of 2026, so Alpha should separate policy-linked incentive effects from underlying operating leverage when constructing risk evidence.
claims.observedWeakness: headline adjusted operating improvement contains a material incentive component
claims.possibleImprovement: show comparable operating-margin improvement excluding incentive effects and supported by revenue/mix/cost execution
claims.falsifier: Subsequent periods showing durable margin expansion independent of the incentive would reduce this concern.

claims.claim: Q2 geographic revenue included $122M shipped to China out of $508M total, while Mobileye also identified China-heavy mix as a contributor to lower ASP; this creates a measurable mix/pricing sensitivity without implying that China exposure is itself a blocker.
claims.observedWeakness: revenue mix is meaningfully exposed to a geography currently associated with lower EyeQ ASP
claims.possibleImprovement: higher-value product penetration, improved China mix economics, or diversification that preserves volume while lifting ASP/margin
claims.falsifier: Evidence that China mix rises while ASP and gross margin remain stable or improve would weaken the sensitivity.

causalEdges: single EyeQ SoC supplier -> component interruption/cost exposure -> shipment fulfillment and margin risk
China-heavy OEM mix -> lower EyeQ ASP -> weaker revenue conversion from shipment growth
higher SuperVision hardware content -> lower gross-margin mix -> advanced-product scaling may not immediately expand gross margin
R&D incentive grant -> reported adjusted operating improvement -> risk of overstating underlying operating leverage if not separated
risks: confidence inflation if incentive-driven margin improvement is treated as purely operational
unknowns: degree of contractual or inventory mitigation around the single EyeQ supplier
future ASP trajectory as China and advanced-product mix evolve
portion of future margin improvement sustainable without R&D incentive effects
recommendedNextState: council-alpha should reuse these source-addressed risk inputs when closing missing_score_risk_evidence; numeric risk and score remain Alpha-owned
